Software Engineering Intern – Summer 2027
Brightline Analytics
Philadelphia, PA (Hybrid – 3 days in office)

About the role
Brightline Analytics builds forecasting tools for regional hospitals. As a Software Engineering Intern on our Platform team, you'll ship features to our React dashboard and the Python services behind it, pair with a mentor every week, and present your project to the company at the end of the summer.

What you'll do
- Build and test React components for our clinician dashboard
- Write Python APIs that serve forecasts to the dashboard
- Add monitoring and alerts for the services you build

What we're looking for
- Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, graduating December 2027 or later
- Experience with Python and JavaScript or TypeScript
- Familiarity with SQL
- Comfortable using Git

Details
Pay: $40–45/hour
Program dates: June 1, 2027 – August 13, 2027 (11 weeks)
Application deadline: January 15, 2027. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Brightline Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.
